    Connectedness of the Auslander–Reiten quiver in Lemma 7.4 and Proposition 7.5 #

    weights-and-parameters.tex, scalar-normalization.tex: "we assume that A is connected. Then Γ_A is connected by [ARS, Theorem VII.2.1]." The generic statements of Lemma 7.4 and Proposition 7.5 (exists_meshWt_lift, res_eq_zero_iff, eq_zero_of_diff, chars_part_of_basis) assume that every vertex is reached from a base projective by a lifted walk (hK), and Proposition 7.2(1) assumes that the projectives of A₀ are connected (A0Conn). Both follow from the connectedness of the quiver (QConn): walks lift to the cover (aconn_of_walk, hK_of_QConn), and lifted projectives in one component of the lifted quiver are connected in L (conn_of_aconn), hence by nonzero pieces of A₀ (A0Conn_of_QConn).

    source
    def MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.MeshWalk.QConn (V : Type) [Quiver V] :
    Prop

    The quiver is connected: any two vertices are joined by a walk of arrows.
